findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "which_thai_visa" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use when someone asks how they can stay in Thailand or which Thai visa or route fits them, e.g. "how can I stay in Thailand for a year", "which visa do I need to retire in Thailand", "can I live in Thailand as a remote worker", "I am married to a Thai, how do I stay", "DTV or LTR or Thailand Privile" → after: "Use this when someone wants to know which visa or legal route lets them stay, live, move to, retire in or work remotely from Thailand, for example "how can I live in Thailand", "best visa to retire in Thailand", "which Thai visa do I need for a year", "moving to Thailand from the USA, which visa", ""

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
